scripts.setup: bun install && bun run setup:backend && bun run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:frontend: cd frontend && bun install && bunx expo install --fix
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "bun run dev:backend" "bun run dev:frontend"
scripts.stop: lsof -ti tcp:8000,8081 | xargs -r sh -c 'kill -CONT "$@"; kill "$@"' stop
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run flask --app server.main run --debug --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.backfill:audit-log: cd backend && uv run python -m server.maintenance.backfill_audit_log
scripts.test:genai: cd backend && uv run python scripts/match_items.py && uv run python scripts/test_group_split.py
